sentences.text: Sir Lucian Grainge serves as Chairman and CEO of Universal Music Group NV, having spent his entire career in the music industry.

Over four decades he has signed and worked with many worldwide stars, including ABBA, Jay Z, Elton John, Katy Perry, Queen, Rihanna, The Rolling Stones, Sam Smith, U2 and Amy Winehouse, pioneering new approaches to the signing and development of the world's most successful recording artists and songwriters.

mgmt_recent.text: In October 2026 UMG deepened a restructuring targeting roughly 270 million dollars in annual savings; Def Jam chairman and CEO Tunji Balogun is to depart by the end of the year, Ben Mortimer is exiting as president of Polydor Label Group, and UK chief artist and strategy officer Rebecca Allen is stepping away after 27 years. CFO Matt Ellis said about 90 million was saved in 2025, with a further 40 to 50 million expected in 2026. Recent appointments include Frank Briegmann, promoted to chairman and CEO for Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Deutsche Grammophon, reporting to Lucian Grainge, Libby Bush as president of global brands and commercial partnerships, and Oscar Celma as senior vice president of applied AI and machine learning.
